task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with exactly two bounded implementation tasks: repair the ordinary route, arena/spatial integrity, camera/Dash lifecycle, and survivor choice presentation; then isolate dense-run profiling so native-host performance evidence can be recaptured without altering release behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The current candidate still lacks a verified ordinary title-to-result route with clean replay, while dense-run qualification is rejected because available evidence comes from llvmpipe software rendering. The next repair must restore authoritative route/lifecycle and spatial behavior, provide the required survivor choice hierarchy and input contracts, and expose bounded dense profiling for eligible-host recapture.

stop_conditions: Stop after both scoped candidate task families have bounded self-checks passing; QA Tester and GameLoop Runtime own runtime recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure.
Do not replace or destructively edit the preserved authored cemetery package or existing authored upgrade hierarchy.
If native renderer qualification remains unavailable, retain truthful instrumentation and report the evidence dependency rather than claiming a performance pass.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior transform tuning: repair authoritative route/lifecycle bindings and collision-aware spatial ownership, replace prose-stacked choices with a real visual hierarchy, and isolate dense profiling behind an explicit tester/profile guard.

code: Run candidate static and project checks covering run lifecycle, InputMap bindings, camera/player state transitions, enemy collision/navigation, upgrade-draft presentation, profile schema, and release-build guards.

Exercise deterministic checks for title→gameplay→Result→Retry→title reset, first-run guidance dismissal, Dash cooldown/reset transitions, zoom clamping and modal isolation, blocked-route recovery, and choice focus ownership.
Validate dense profile receipt schema, warm-up/measured separation, percentile calculations, entity-count accounting, cleanup/reset accounting, and renderer identity.
runtime: QA Tester should use ordinary input to complete the five-wave route, inspect first-run guidance, collect wisps, make upgrade choices, reach Result, test failure and victory branches, inspect statistics/Credits/provenance, then Retry and return to title.

QA Tester should replay ordinary movement around every side of the central building/landmark and along the perimeter/boundary, verify external world/external depth, collision, stable visibility, no disappearance/occlusion, readable enemies, and coffin/grave/gravestone/wall/building blocked-route recovery.
QA Tester should verify mouse-wheel and gamepad minimum/default/maximum zoom with modal input isolation and repeatable Dash across pause, damage, death, Retry, and title return.

QA Tester should inspect the upgrade/weapon page for silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new deltas (≤3), restrained copy, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states, then confirm authoritative selected id/rank/modifier state changes combat behavior instead of only text labels.
visual: Capture title, first-run guidance, ordinary arena traversal, central landmark/building near-contact and departure, four perimeter/boundary views with external depth, and dense combat at readable enemy scale.
Capture the choice page with authored silhouette/icon hierarchy, current-to-new values, no more than three deltas, and visible keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.
Capture Result, failure, Retry, title return, and clean re-entry states without stale actors or HUD.
Capture dense-profile evidence views/receipts for representative final-wave and boss density; Tester must record whether the renderer is eligible for native performance qualification.

done_when: First-run guidance teaches movement, repeatable Dash, automatic attack, pickup collection, and the first upgrade using live InputMap glyphs plus a shipped-art gameplay illustration; it is short, dismissible, does not consume combat input, and does not reappear on Retry.

A normal seven-to-ten-minute title-to-Result route advances through all five authored waves and Bellkeeper victory without diagnostic fixtures; Result exposes time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt/taken, selected upgrades, and victory/failure, and Retry/title return clear actors, timers, pause ownership, audio, focus, and authoritative state.
The same candidate supports both ordinary failure and victory branches, three distinct successful build shapes, Credits & Notices/provenance presentation, and replay from a clean run.

The authored cemetery provides larger traversable scale or an expanded play space plus coherent external world/external depth beyond the gameplay boundary. The central building/landmark and full perimeter/boundary retain aligned collision and stable visibility during ordinary movement/movement replay, with no disappearance or occlusion drift.

Ordinary enemies stay at readable/legible enemy scale, cannot enter coffin/grave/gravestone/wall/building blockers, and recover through blocked-route navigation. Camera zoom has clamped mouse-wheel and gamepad minimum/default/maximum bounds with modal input isolation. Dash is repeatable after cooldown across pause, damage, death, Retry, and title return.

Upgrade and weapon choices use visual hierarchy with authored silhouettes or icons, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, no NEW/LOCKED placeholders in CURRENT, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected states.
Automatic combat remains automatic and causally visible through target selection, attack, hit, damage, death, drop, pickup, and visibly changed upgrade behavior.
Tester can black-box replay the ordinary route and white-box inspect route, reset, collision, camera, Dash, enemy recovery, and choice bindings in the same loop for the active issue.
tasks.instructions: Own the ordinary release surface across the authoritative run controller, wave director, authored cemetery spatial contract, camera, player/Warden, enemy navigation, and the real upgrade-draft/weapon-choice presenter. Restore a complete ordinary title-to-result route with five waves, Bellkeeper victory and failure branches, result statistics, three viable successful build shapes, Credits & Notices/provenance, Retry, and title return. Preserve one intact authored cemetery instance while making a real larger traversable scale or expanded play space and adding non-playable external world/external depth. Reconcile central building/landmark and perimeter/boundary geometry with collision, camera occlusion handling, spawn exclusion, and navigation; test ordinary movement/movement replay and blocked-route recovery for coffin/grave/gravestone/wall/building obstacles. Implement readable/legible ordinary enemy scale, clamped mouse-wheel and gamepad minimum/default/maximum zoom, modal input isolation, and repeatable Dash across pause, damage, death, Retry, and title return. Replace text-stacked upgrade and weapon choices with visual hierarchy, silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, restrained copy, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus. Include contextual first-run guidance with live input glyphs and shipped-art illustration. Do not implement dense telemetry or renderer profiling in this task.

Profile collection is disabled or inert in normal release play and does not redesign HUD, upgrade visuals, camera/player behavior, authored world composition, or weapon assets.
